title: LifecycleRun workflow_steps ledger v1
description: The shape of the additive LifecycleRun.workflow_steps control-plane ledger (v0.1.30 Item 5). Each entry is one produced step payload's ledger record, addressed by (run_id, producer_step, attempt), pointing at the immutable on-disk payload (payload_ref + content_hash) and carrying the declared downstream consumers plus the recorded consumptions. The ledger is additive-optional: an old LifecycleRun with no 'workflow_steps' key loads as an empty ledger (A27); the run-store schema literal is NOT bumped.

run_id.description: The LifecycleRun id. Implicit per run; recorded for addressable-key completeness.

producer_step.description: The workflow step that produced the payload.

attempt.description: Zero-based attempt number of the producer step.

output_schema.description: The named payload schema the on-disk payload conforms to.

payload_ref.description: Workspace-relative path to the immutable on-disk payload envelope under .dadaia/runs/lifecycle/<run_id>/steps/.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the on-disk payload envelope bytes — proves immutability.

produced_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp ending in Z.

declared_consumers.description: Downstream step names declaring a 'consumes' edge on this payload.

consumer_step.description: The downstream step that consumed the payload.

consumer_attempt.description: Zero-based attempt number of the consuming step (A24 exact-by-attempt).

consumed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the consumption was recorded.
